profile.headline: POCL Achieves Highest-Ever Quarterly Revenue and EBITDA in Q2 FY26

description.text: Pondy Oxides and Chemicals Limited is a leading global recycling company with 30 years of experience, operating in four recycling verticals: lead, plastics, copper, and aluminium. The company adopts responsible and sustainable manufacturing practices to process scraps into high-quality metal and non-metal by-products.
description.quote: 30 Years of Experience | 11% - 5 Years Revenue CAGR

highlights.text: Standalone Net Revenue for Q2FY26 grew 11% year-on-year to Rs. 6,345 Million.
EBITDA for the quarter rose by 84% year-on-year to Rs. 551 Million, with a margin of 8.7%.
Profit After Tax (PAT) increased by 105% year-on-year to Rs. 356 Million in Q2FY26.
Lead production for H1FY26 reached 47,408 MT, up from 45,959 MT in the previous year.

keyHighlights.text: The company reported its highest-ever quarterly and half-yearly revenue, EBITDA, PAT, and margins.
keyHighlights.quote: POCL has achieved its highest-ever quarterly and half-yearly revenue, EBITDA, PAT, and margins, underpinned by strong operational execution.

keyHighlights.text: Phase 1 of the Lead capacity expansion project added 36,000 MTPA in April 2025, with Phase 2 expected to be commissioned in H2 FY26.
The company aims for EBITDA margins above 8%, ROCE over 20%, and over 60% of revenue from value-added products.
keyHighlights.quote: We aim to achieve EBITDA margins above 8%, ROCE over 20%, and generate more than 60% of revenue from value-added products.

keyHighlights.text: POCL raised INR 132.5 Crs through a preferential issue and INR 175 crores through a QIP in 2024-2025.
The company maintains a strong financial position with a healthy net cash position as of H1FY26.
keyHighlights.quote: Supported by a clear strategic roadmap, strong financial health with a healthy net cash position, disciplined operations, a favorable regulatory environment

outlook.text: POCL is focused on its Target 2030 vision, targeting over 15% volume growth and sustaining a revenue CAGR above 20%. Strategic initiatives include exploring Lithium Ion recycling, E-waste, and increasing copper capacity, while commissioning Phase 2 of Lead capacity expansion in the second half of FY26.

cell.quote: A/ Stable External rating from CRISIL

guidance.text: The company aims to deliver over 15% volume growth and sustain a revenue CAGR above 20% by 2030.
guidance.quote: Our strategic priorities include delivering over 15% volume growth, sustaining a revenue CAGR above 20%, and significantly enhancing profitability.

guidance.text: Management targets EBITDA margins above 8% and ROCE over 20%.
guidance.quote: We aim to achieve EBITDA margins above 8%, ROCE over 20%, and generate more than 60% of revenue from value-added products.

guidance.text: The second phase of the Lead capacity expansion project is expected to be commissioned in H2 FY26.
guidance.quote: Phase 2 is expected to commissioned in H2’FY26 .

guidance.text: Estimated capital expenditure for the second half of FY26 is Rs. 35 crore.
